# Metrics reference

<!-- Generated by `hangar reference metrics`. Do not edit; run `make generate`. -->

Hangar exports these metrics over OTLP, or on `/metrics` when `telemetry.metrics` is `prometheus`. HTTP server and client metrics follow the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions (`http.server.request.duration`, `http.server.active_requests` and the body size histograms), and Go runtime metrics come from the runtime instrumentation. Repo IDs are never metric attributes; they are on spans and logs.

Gauges that need a database count are computed by one worker at a time every 60 seconds.

| Metric | Prometheus name | Type | Unit | Attributes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hangar.download.bytes` | `hangar_download_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | `protocol`, `mode` (`redirect`, `proxy`), `repo.type` | Bytes downloaded by clients. |
| `hangar.download.files` | `hangar_download_files_total` | counter | `{file}` | `protocol`, `repo.type` | Files downloaded by clients. |
| `hangar.upload.bytes` | `hangar_upload_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | `protocol` | Bytes uploaded by clients. |
| `hangar.pull.bytes` | `hangar_pull_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | `upstream` | Bytes transferred from Upstreams by Pulls. |
| `hangar.pull.rate_limited.duration` | `hangar_pull_rate_limited_duration_seconds_total` | counter | `s` | `upstream` | Time Pulls spent waiting for the bandwidth limit. |
| `hangar.pull.files` | `hangar_pull_files_total` | counter | `{file}` | `upstream`, `outcome` (`ok`, `retry`, `failed`, `deduplicated`) | Files transferred by Pulls, by outcome. |
| `hangar.jobs.queued` | `hangar_jobs_queued` | gauge | `{job}` | `kind`, `status` | Jobs by kind and status. |
| `hangar.jobs.duration` | `hangar_jobs_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | `kind`, `outcome` | Job run time, by kind and outcome. |
| `hangar.jobs.lease.expired` | `hangar_jobs_lease_expired_total` | counter | `{job}` | `kind` | Jobs whose lease expired and went back to the queue. |
| `hangar.git.push` | `hangar_git_push_total` | counter | `{push}` | `outcome` (`ok`, `rejected`, `conflict`, `error`) | git pushes, by outcome. |
| `hangar.git.pack.duration` | `hangar_git_pack_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | `service` (`upload-pack`, `receive-pack`) | git pack generation and receive time. |
| `hangar.git.cache.requests` | `hangar_git_cache_requests_total` | counter | `{request}` | `outcome` (`hit`, `miss`) | Local pack cache lookups, by outcome. |
| `hangar.git.cache.bytes` | `hangar_git_cache_bytes` | gauge | `By` | - | Size of the local pack cache. |
| `hangar.git.packs` | `hangar_git_packs` | gauge | `{pack}` | `state` | git packs by state, reported by compaction runs. |
| `hangar.xet.xorbs` | `hangar_xet_xorbs_total` | counter | `{xorb}` | `outcome` (`inserted`, `existing`, `rejected`) | Xet xorb uploads, by outcome. |
| `hangar.xet.reassembly.duration` | `hangar_xet_reassembly_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | `outcome` | Time to reassemble Xet uploads into LFS objects. |
| `hangar.xet.reassembly.bytes` | `hangar_xet_reassembly_bytes_total` | counter | `By` | - | Bytes reassembled from Xet uploads. |
| `hangar.blob.operation.duration` | `hangar_blob_operation_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | `backend`, `operation`, `outcome` | Blob store operation time. |
| `hangar.storage.bytes` | `hangar_storage_bytes` | gauge | `By` | `kind` (`lfs`, `git`) | Stored bytes by kind, reported by GC runs. |
| `hangar.repos` | `hangar_repos` | gauge | `{repo}` | `type`, `visibility`, `mirror` | Repos by type, visibility and Mirror state. |
| `hangar.users` | `hangar_users` | gauge | `{user}` | - | Users. |
| `hangar.auth.attempts` | `hangar_auth_attempts_total` | counter | `{attempt}` | `method` (`password`, `oidc`, `token`, `ollama_key`), `outcome` | Authentication attempts, by method and outcome. |
| `hangar.webhook.deliveries` | `hangar_webhook_deliveries_total` | counter | `{delivery}` | `outcome` | Webhook deliveries, by outcome. |
| `hangar.index.duration` | `hangar_index_duration_seconds` | histogram | `s` | `outcome` | Index run time, by outcome. |
| `hangar.scan.files` | `hangar_scan_files_total` | counter | `{file}` | `status` | Scanned files, by status. |
